Appearance.Position.name: Position
Appearance.Position.description: Where the island should appear on your screen.

Appearance.TargetMonitor.name: Target Monitor
Appearance.TargetMonitor.description: Select the screen to display the island. If a display isn't found, it safely falls back to the Primary Monitor.

Appearance.Displays.name: Displays
Appearance.Displays.description: single = only the Target Monitor; all = the island on the Target Monitor plus a mirror on every other display.

Appearance.DisplayLink.name: Islands on several displays
Appearance.DisplayLink.description: With the island on all displays. Linked: every island works; pointing at any of them opens them all together, and clicks and scrolling work on each. Separate: the island you point at opens on its own, using that display's position; the others stay as they are.

Appearance.MirrorPosition.name: Mirror position
Appearance.MirrorPosition.description: Where mirrors sit on the other displays (same = like the main island).

Appearance.DisplayPositions.name: Per-display positions
Appearance.DisplayPositions.description: Optional overrides by display number, e.g. 2=bottom-center;3=top-left

Appearance.DisplayShapes.name: Per-display shapes
Appearance.DisplayShapes.description: With separate islands on several displays: a shape by display number (pill, w11 or notch), e.g. 2=pill;3=notch. Others use Island Shape Style.

Appearance.DisplaySizes.name: Per-display sizes
Appearance.DisplaySizes.description: With separate islands on several displays: a size by display number, relative to Size scale, e.g. 2=1.2;3=0.9.

Appearance.OffsetX.name: Offset X
Appearance.OffsetX.description: Adjust the horizontal position (in pixels). Positive values move it right, negative values move it left.

Appearance.OffsetY.name: Offset Y
Appearance.OffsetY.description: Adjust the vertical position (in pixels). Positive values move it down, negative values move it up. Applies to every state unless the separate expanded offset below is turned on, in which case this becomes the collapsed/idle offset.

Appearance.SeparateExpandedOffsetY.name: Use a separate Offset Y when expanded
Appearance.SeparateExpandedOffsetY.description: Lets the island sit at one height while collapsed and a different one while expanded. Useful for tucking the idle pill up near the screen edge while keeping the expanded dashboard somewhere comfortable to interact with.

Appearance.OffsetYExpanded.name: Offset Y (expanded)
Appearance.OffsetYExpanded.description: Vertical position in pixels while the island is expanded. Only used when the separate expanded offset above is on. The island eases between this and Offset Y as it expands and collapses, so the two never snap.

Appearance.BorderMergedMode.name: Border-Merged Mode
Appearance.BorderMergedMode.description: Attach the island flush to the top edge of the monitor without a floating gap.

Appearance.ShapeStyle.name: Island Shape Style
Appearance.ShapeStyle.description: Change the overall shape of the island (Notch, Pill or Windows 11). Notch is the default: flush with the top of the screen.

Appearance.ProgressStyle.name: Progress bar style
Appearance.ProgressStyle.description: Look of the song progress bar in the expanded media player. Wavy and Squiggle animate while music is playing and flatten when paused.

options.label: Bar (thick bar with a line thumb)

Appearance.SpectrumStyle.name: Audio spectrum style
Appearance.SpectrumStyle.description: Look of the live audio visualizer next to the album art (collapsed pill and expanded player). Pulse Orb, Plasma Thread and Peak Matrix use a real frequency analysis of the system audio, and each plays its own animation when the track changes.

Appearance.SizeScale.name: Size scale
Appearance.SizeScale.description: Makes the whole island larger or smaller, its cards, text and icons together, from 0.6x to 2.5x.

Appearance.AutoDpiScale.name: Auto DPI scaling
Appearance.AutoDpiScale.description: Automatically scales the island to match your monitor's DPI. Recommended for 4K screens.

Appearance.MatchScreenSize.name: Match screen size
Appearance.MatchScreenSize.description: The island grows with bigger screens, so it takes the same share of each one. A 1080p screen is 1x, 1440p about 1.3x, 4K 2x, and it re-sizes when it moves to another monitor. It never goes below your display scaling (Auto DPI scaling), and Size scale still fine-tunes it.

Behavior.AlwaysOnTop.name: Always on top
Behavior.AlwaysOnTop.description: Keeps the island above all other windows. Turn this off if it blocks other apps.

Behavior.ExpandOnHover.name: Expand on hover
Behavior.ExpandOnHover.description: Expand the island automatically when hovered. If disabled, click to expand.

Behavior.AutoHideIdleSeconds.name: Auto-hide island (all states)
Behavior.AutoHideIdleSeconds.description: Hide the island (including idle, media, and other states) after this many seconds of inactivity. 0 to disable.

Behavior.FullscreenMode.name: In full screen
Behavior.FullscreenMode.description: What the island does while a video, game or app is full screen. Tuck folds it into a thin line (point at the line to bring it back; it unfolds when you leave full screen or an agent needs you). Show keeps the island as usual, hover and all. Hide takes it away until you leave full screen. On Linux this needs X11 (GNOME on Wayland runs Bunbun through XWayland).

Behavior.FullscreenShowApps.name: Always show over these apps
Behavior.FullscreenShowApps.description: Apps where the island stays as usual in full screen, whatever In full screen says. Names separated by commas, for example chrome, vlc. A part of the name is enough.

Behavior.FullscreenTuckApps.name: Always tuck over these apps
Behavior.FullscreenTuckApps.description: Apps where the island tucks into a line in full screen. Names separated by commas.

Behavior.FullscreenHideApps.name: Always hide over these apps
Behavior.FullscreenHideApps.description: Apps where the island hides in full screen, for example games. Names separated by commas.

Behavior.UnhideOnHover.name: Unhide on hover
Behavior.UnhideOnHover.description: Allow the hidden island to reappear when you hover your mouse over it.

Animations.TargetFPS.name: Refresh rate / FPS
Animations.TargetFPS.description: Set the animation frame rate. Choose Auto to dynamically match your active monitor's refresh rate (up to 360Hz/500Hz), or select a fixed FPS.

Animations.AnimationStyle.name: Animation bounciness / style
Animations.AnimationStyle.description: Control the spring physics and feel of the animation.

Animations.PowerSaver.name: Battery saver
Animations.PowerSaver.description: Fewer wakeups and lower animation frame rates so the island sips power. Auto turns it on while the PC runs on battery or Windows battery saver is on.

Animations.AnimationSpeed.name: Animation speed
Animations.AnimationSpeed.description: How fast the island expands and collapses.

Animations.ExpandedMediaTransitions.name: Expanded player transitions
Animations.ExpandedMediaTransitions.description: Animate the hover player when the song changes or you press a control - title, artist and album text, the cover flip, and the previous / next / play-pause buttons. Turn off to make them change instantly.

Animations.PillCoverSpin.name: Pill cover spin
Animations.PillCoverSpin.description: Spin the album cover in the collapsed pill when the song changes. Turn off to swap the cover instantly.

Themes.ThemePreset.name: Theme preset
Themes.ThemePreset.description: Select a curated color theme, or choose Custom to use your own hex colors below.

Themes.IslandFill.name: Fill
Themes.IslandFill.description: Transparent uses the theme's colour with the transparency and blur settings below. Opaque paints the island one steady solid colour (Solid colour), with nothing showing through and no album-art tint.

Themes.SolidColor.name: Solid colour
Themes.SolidColor.description: The colour of the island when Fill is Opaque. Black by default; any 6-digit hex works.

Themes.PillOpacity.name: Pill transparency
Themes.PillOpacity.description: 35 to 100. Lower values make the island more see-through.

Themes.TintIntensity.name: Background tint intensity
Themes.TintIntensity.description: 0 to 100. Controls how dark the background tint behind the island is.

Themes.BackdropMaterial.name: Backdrop material (real Windows blur)
Themes.BackdropMaterial.description: Paints genuine Windows blur or acrylic behind the island so your desktop and windows show through it, using the same effect the system uses for its own surfaces. Acrylic adds Windows' frosted grain and a tint of your background colour (see Acrylic tint strength). Requires Windows 10 1803 or newer, and Windows' Transparency effects must be turned ON (Settings > Personalization > Colors > Transparency effects, or on Windows 11 also Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects). If it is off, or Battery saver is on, you will only see a flat tint with no blur. When this is on, use Backdrop fill opacity below to control how much of the blur comes through.

Themes.BackdropFillOpacity.name: Backdrop fill opacity
Themes.BackdropFillOpacity.description: 0 to 100. Only used when a Backdrop material is enabled. How opaque the island's own background stays on top of the blur - lower values let more of the blurred desktop through. Has no effect when the backdrop is Off.

Themes.BackdropTint.name: Acrylic tint strength
Themes.BackdropTint.description: 0 to 100. How strongly your background colour tints the backdrop. Acrylic uses the full strength; Blur uses a lighter wash of the same colour so the desktop stays readable.

Themes.MaterialDepth.name: Depth shading
Themes.MaterialDepth.description: Adds soft downward shading and the accent wash so the island has depth instead of looking like one flat fill. No edge highlights or rim lighting are involved. Turn off for a completely flat look.

Themes.DropShadow.name: Soft drop shadow
Themes.DropShadow.description: Casts a soft shadow beneath the island to lift it off the desktop.

Themes.AccentBloom.name: Accent bloom intensity
Themes.AccentBloom.description: 0 to 200. Strength of the soft accent-coloured wash bleeding in from the top of the island. Driven by album art when the accent mode is Auto. Set to 0 to remove it.

Themes.TextScale.name: Text size
Themes.TextScale.description: 70 to 160. Scales all island text independently of the overall Size scale, so you can keep the island compact while making the clock and labels easier to read.

Themes.AccentColorMode.name: Accent color mode
Themes.AccentColorMode.description: How the island's accent colour (and the settings app's) is chosen. Dynamic: from the album art of what's playing, the solid colour when nothing is. Solid: one fixed colour. System: the device accent.

Themes.CustomAccentHex.name: Solid accent colour
Themes.CustomAccentHex.description: The accent colour when the accent is Solid, and while nothing is playing in Dynamic.

Themes.CalendarAccent.name: Calendar accent color
Themes.CalendarAccent.description: Accent color for the calendar's month name and today's marker. Default uses the island's accent color mode; System always uses the Windows accent.

Themes.ClockAccentGlow.name: Show clock background circle/glow
Themes.ClockAccentGlow.description: Display the soft accent circle/glow behind the time in the expanded clock view. Turn off for a clean, minimal clock without background glow.

Themes.FontFamily.name: Font family
Themes.FontFamily.description: Custom font family for island text (e.g. Segoe UI, Arial, Aptos, Consolas). Leave empty for system default.

Themes.ContourBorderMode.name: Contour border
Themes.ContourBorderMode.description: Choose the island's border style. Default uses the theme's matching border, Auto extracts the border color from album art, and Borderless removes all outer border outlines.

Themes.ContourBorderHex.name: Contour border hex color
Themes.ContourBorderHex.description: Hex color for the island contour stroke. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.PillBgColor.name: Pill background color
Themes.PillBgColor.description: Hex color for the island background. Accepts 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits, so use the 8-digit RRGGBBAA form for a translucent background (for example 0D0D0FB0) while keeping the text and icons opaque. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.TextPrimaryColor.name: Primary text color
Themes.TextPrimaryColor.description: Accessible hex color for titles and main text. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Themes.TextSecondaryColor.name: Secondary text color
Themes.TextSecondaryColor.description: Accessible hex color for artist names and muted labels. Changing it from the default overrides the selected Theme preset; restore the default to go back to the preset.

Indicators.PrivacyDots.name: Show privacy indicators (Mic & Camera)
Indicators.PrivacyDots.description: Master toggle to display the iOS-style privacy dots when microphone or camera is in use.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsMic.name: Show microphone indicator (Orange dot)
Indicators.PrivacyDotsMic.description: Show the orange dot when microphone is in use. Turn off if background apps (like Discord/OBS) keep it permanently active.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsMicHex.name: Microphone dot color
Indicators.PrivacyDotsMicHex.description: Custom hex color for microphone privacy indicator.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsCam.name: Show camera indicator (Green dot)
Indicators.PrivacyDotsCam.description: Show the green dot when webcam is in use.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsCamHex.name: Camera dot color
Indicators.PrivacyDotsCamHex.description: Custom hex color for camera privacy indicator.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsScreen.name: Show screen sharing and recording indicator (Blue dot)
Indicators.PrivacyDotsScreen.description: One blue dot while your screen is shared or recorded: OBS recording or streaming, a browser sharing your screen (Google Meet and the like), and apps using the system's capture: on Windows its capture API (Snipping Tool, Teams, Discord), Xbox Game Bar, Camtasia and ShareX; on Linux PipeWire screen sharing (Discord, Zoom, GNOME's recorder), ffmpeg, wf-recorder, gpu-screen-recorder and SimpleScreenRecorder.

Indicators.PrivacyDotsScreenHex.name: Screen-recording dot color
Indicators.PrivacyDotsScreenHex.description: Custom hex color for the screen-recording indicator.

Modules.Media.name: Media module
Modules.Media.description: Shows album art, song info, and playback controls when music is playing.

Modules.MediaAutoExpand.name: Auto-expand on track change
Modules.MediaAutoExpand.description: Automatically expand the island when a new song starts playing. Videos (the Streaming pill) never expand on their own. If disabled, album art updates smoothly in the collapsed pill without unprompted expansion.

Modules.CollapsedTitle.name: Song title in the collapsed pill
Modules.CollapsedTitle.description: While music plays, the collapsed pill shows the song title next to the cover. Right-click the island and pick "Show lyrics on collapsed island" to show synced lyrics there instead.

Modules.MediaPillClock.name: Show clock in the collapsed media pill
Modules.MediaPillClock.description: While media is playing, the collapsed pill also shows the current time on the left, separated from the album cover by a thin divider. Hovering still opens the normal player. Uses the same 12h/24h and seconds options as the clock below. Off by default.

Modules.Volume.name: Volume slider flyout
Modules.Volume.description: Shows a volume slider banner on the island when adjusting system volume. Disable if you prefer the default Windows volume flyout.

Modules.Brightness.name: Brightness slider flyout
Modules.Brightness.description: Shows a brightness slider banner on the island when you change the screen brightness. Works with a laptop's built-in display. Disable if you prefer the default Windows brightness flyout.

Modules.CapsLock.name: Caps Lock module
Modules.CapsLock.description: Shows an indicator when Caps Lock or Num Lock state changes.

Modules.Battery.name: Battery module
Modules.Battery.description: Shows an alert when your laptop battery is running low.

Modules.BluetoothIndicator.name: Bluetooth connect/disconnect indicator
Modules.BluetoothIndicator.description: Shows a card with the device name, category icon, and battery level (if available) when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects.

Modules.BluetoothShowBattery.name: Show Bluetooth battery level
Modules.BluetoothShowBattery.description: Reads battery level over BLE GATT when the device supports it. Not all classic Bluetooth devices report battery this way — when unavailable, only a Connected/Disconnected label is shown.

Modules.Progress.name: Progress module
Modules.Progress.description: Shows a progress ring around the island for downloads or file copies.

Modules.TimerModule.name: Focus Timer module
Modules.TimerModule.description: Enables a Pomodoro-style focus/break timer, startable from the island's right-click menu.

Modules.Clipboard.name: Clipboard module
Modules.Clipboard.description: Shows a quick preview of the text or images you just copied.

Modules.StatusCountdownProgress.name: Status countdown progress bar
Modules.StatusCountdownProgress.description: Shows a subtle countdown progress bar at the bottom of temporary status alert cards (such as Clipboard, Notifications, and Device alerts). Disabled by default.

Modules.DoNotDisturbIndicator.name: Do Not Disturb status alert
Modules.DoNotDisturbIndicator.description: Shows a status alert card when Do Not Disturb is toggled in the Windows notification panel.

Modules.NotificationRespectDnD.name: Follow Windows' Do Not Disturb
Modules.NotificationRespectDnD.description: On, the island stays quiet while Windows' Do Not Disturb is on, like Windows does. Off, your apps' notifications still show on the island during Do Not Disturb (Windows itself keeps them quiet).

Modules.HardwareMonitorModule.name: Include Hardware Monitor in scroll loop
Modules.HardwareMonitorModule.description: Add CPU, GPU, RAM, FPS and Network stats card to mouse-wheel scroll loop.

Modules.ConnectivityModule.name: Include Connectivity in scroll loop
Modules.ConnectivityModule.description: Add a Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb (and, on laptops, Battery) tab to the mouse-wheel scroll loop. Click Wi-Fi or Bluetooth to turn it on or off, hold it to pick a network or device, right-click any card for its Windows settings.

Modules.TodoModule.name: To-do tab and reminders
Modules.TodoModule.description: A To-do tab in the scroll loop (click a row to tick it off) and reminder pills with Snooze and Done. Ask Bun adds them: "add buy milk", "remind me at 3pm to call Sam", "remind me in 20 min to stretch", "my list", "done buy milk". Saved on this PC only (todos.tsv next to settings.ini).

Modules.ReminderSound.name: Reminder sound
Modules.ReminderSound.description: Play Windows' reminder sound when a reminder is due. Change the sound itself in Windows' Sound settings → More sound settings → Sounds → Calendar Reminder.

Modules.QuietReminders.name: Quiet reminders
Modules.QuietReminders.description: While a full-screen app runs, you're presenting, a meeting from your calendar is on, or Focus mode is on, reminders don't play a sound and show as a small pill. Tap it to see Snooze and Done.

Modules.CalendarIcsUrl.name: Calendar link
Modules.CalendarIcsUrl.description: Your calendar's private iCal link (Google Calendar → Settings → your calendar → "Secret address in iCal format"; Outlook.com → Settings → Shared calendars → Publish → ICS). Several links can go in, separated by spaces. Bunbun fetches it every 5 minutes to show your next meeting with a Join button. Keep it private; anyone with the link can read the calendar.

Modules.CalendarHolidays.name: Holidays and festivals
Modules.CalendarHolidays.description: Adds your country's public holidays and festivals to the calendar page, from Google's public holiday calendar. Needs no sign-in.

Modules.MeetingAlertMinutes.name: Meeting alert (minutes before)
Modules.MeetingAlertMinutes.description: How long before a meeting the island shows it with a countdown and Join button. 0 turns the alert off (the calendar tab still shows what's next).

Modules.Downloads.name: Download progress
Modules.Downloads.description: Shows browser downloads in your Downloads folder as they come in (name, size, speed), then "Downloaded". Click the finished pill to show the file.

Modules.GameOverlay.name: Enable game overlay mode
Modules.GameOverlay.description: Replaces the clock with live stats like FPS, CPU, and RAM usage.

Modules.ShowMetricText.name: Show labels in metric chips
Modules.ShowMetricText.description: Adds text labels (like "CPU") inside the game overlay bars.

Modules.Weather.name: Weather module
Modules.Weather.description: Shows the weather on the right side of the pill. Turn off to only show the clock.

Modules.WeatherCity.name: Weather City (Optional)
Modules.WeatherCity.description: A city (e.g. London) to always show. Leave blank to show the weather where this PC is, from Windows' location service.

Modules.WeatherFahrenheit.name: Use Fahrenheit
Modules.WeatherFahrenheit.description: Display weather temperature and wind speed in imperial units.

Modules.MediaTabLyrics.name: Lyrics in the media tab
Modules.MediaTabLyrics.description: Adds a lyrics button to the media player controls to toggle an immersive lyrics view over the media tab. Can also be toggled from the right-click menu.

Modules.Lyrics.name: Lyrics module
Modules.Lyrics.description: Shows synced lyrics for the current track (fetched from LRCLIB, a free open-source lyrics database) while the island is expanded. Scroll to the Lyrics tab to view them.

Modules.LyricsVisualizer.name: Show visualizer in Lyrics tab
Modules.LyricsVisualizer.description: Shows a small live audio waveform next to the Lyrics title while a track is playing.

Modules.KaraokeLyrics.name: Karaoke-style glow
Modules.KaraokeLyrics.description: Lights up the active lyric line progressively, left to right, in sync with the song.

Modules.KaraokeLetterGlow.name: Karaoke letter glow
Modules.KaraokeLetterGlow.description: As the karaoke light sweeps across the line, letters near the wipe boundary softly glow, then fade out behind it.

Modules.LyricsOffsetMs.name: Lyrics sync offset - speakers / wired (ms)
Modules.LyricsOffsetMs.description: Fine-tunes lyric timing in milliseconds (-3000 to 3000, 1 ms steps). Positive = lyrics appear EARLIER, negative = LATER. Raise it if lyrics feel late, lower it if they feel early. Applies to every lyric view (Lyrics tab, collapsed pill, media-tab panel and the karaoke wipe). This value is used whenever the default audio output is NOT a Bluetooth device. You can also nudge it from the right-click menu under Lyrics sync.

Modules.LyricsOffsetBluetoothMs.name: Lyrics sync offset - Bluetooth output (ms)
Modules.LyricsOffsetBluetoothMs.description: Same as above (-3000 to 3000 ms, positive = EARLIER, negative = LATER), but used automatically while the default audio output is a Bluetooth device. Bluetooth adds latency, so lyrics usually need to be shifted LATER (a negative value) here. The island switches between the two values by itself when the output changes.

Modules.LyricsNeighborLinesVisible.name: Show neighboring lyric lines clearly
Modules.LyricsNeighborLinesVisible.description: By default the lines above and below the active line are only a faint ghost. Turn this on to make them clearly readable.

Modules.LyricsCache.name: Lyrics cache (disk)
Modules.LyricsCache.description: Instant lyrics, less load on LRCLIB, tiny disk use, clearable anytime. Stored in the mod's storage folder. Turn off to stop all lyrics disk reads and writes.

Modules.LyricsCacheMaxMB.name: Lyrics cache size limit
Modules.LyricsCacheMaxMB.description: Least recently used files are deleted once the cache grows past this. Off disables the disk cache.

Modules.LyricsNetEase.name: Also search NetEase
Modules.LyricsNetEase.description: When LRCLIB has no synced lyrics for a song, also look on NetEase Cloud Music, which has many Chinese, Japanese and Korean songs. This sends the song title and artist to music.163.com. Only a match with the same title, artist and length is shown.

Modules.Language.name: Language
Modules.Language.description: Language for the island's own text labels. Auto follows your Windows display language.

Modules.ClockFormat.name: Clock format
Modules.ClockFormat.description: Choose 12-hour or 24-hour time, or follow your Windows locale setting.

Modules.ShowSeconds.name: Show seconds on the clock
Modules.ShowSeconds.description: Include seconds in the expanded clock. Costs a little more CPU because the clock then redraws every second.

Modules.DateFormat.name: Custom date format
Modules.DateFormat.description: Custom date pattern for the idle dashboard. Leave empty to follow your Windows locale. Supports yyyy (year), MM / M (month), dd / d (day), MMM (short month name), MMMM (full month name), ddd / dddd (weekday). Any other characters are printed as-is, so CJK formats like yyyy年MM月dd日 work.

Modules.DateFirst.name: Show date above the time
Modules.DateFirst.description: Swap the idle dashboard so the date is the headline and the time sits beneath it.

Modules.FirstDayOfWeek.name: First day of the week
Modules.FirstDayOfWeek.description: Which weekday the calendar grid starts on. Auto follows your Windows regional format.

Modules.QuickLookup.name: Quick Lookup (hotkey)
Modules.QuickLookup.description: Press the Ask Bun hotkey (set on the Assistant & agents page) to open a search box on the island. Type a word or short phrase and press Enter, or pick your clipboard text or a recent lookup. Nothing is sent anywhere until you submit a search; searches go to en.wiktionary.org and en.wikipedia.org (and api.dictionaryapi.dev as a backup dictionary). Recent lookups are kept in memory only and cleared when the mod restarts.

Modules.FileTrayModule.name: File Tray (drag & drop shelf)
Modules.FileTrayModule.description: Adds a File Tray card to the scroll loop. Drag files onto the island to park them there, then click to open one, or use the right-click menu to clear the shelf. Files are only referenced, never copied or moved.

Modules.FileTrayMaxItems.name: File Tray capacity
Modules.FileTrayMaxItems.description: 1 to 25. How many files the shelf keeps before the oldest one drops off.

Modules.FileTrayPersist.name: File Tray remembers items (disk)
Modules.FileTrayPersist.description: Keeps the tray's contents across restarts, in the mod's storage folder. Only file paths and pasted text snippets are stored, never copies of your files. Turn off to stop all disk reads and writes and delete the saved list.

Modules.MediaExpandBlocklist.name: Never auto-expand for these apps
Modules.MediaExpandBlocklist.description: Comma-separated list of app or site names that should never make the island expand on a track change, while still updating quietly in the collapsed pill. Matched loosely against the media source and title, for example: chrome, tiktok, youtube.

Modules.GameOverlayShowFps.name: Game overlay - show FPS
Modules.GameOverlayShowFps.description: Include the frame rate in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowCpu.name: Game overlay - show CPU
Modules.GameOverlayShowCpu.description: Include CPU utilization in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowGpu.name: Game overlay - show GPU
Modules.GameOverlayShowGpu.description: Include GPU utilization in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowRam.name: Game overlay - show RAM
Modules.GameOverlayShowRam.description: Include memory usage in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayShowDisk.name: Game overlay - show disk
Modules.GameOverlayShowDisk.description: Include disk usage in the game overlay strip.

Modules.GameOverlayCompact.name: Game overlay - compact size
Modules.GameOverlayCompact.description: Shrink the game overlay to a narrow strip that fits neatly inside the taskbar area.

Shortcuts.HideShowHotkeyEnabled.name: Enable hide/show hotkey
Shortcuts.HideShowHotkeyEnabled.description: Toggle the island's visibility instantly with a keyboard shortcut. The hotkey is the only way to bring a hidden island back, so leave this on unless you're comfortable re-enabling it from settings.ini.

Shortcuts.HideShowModifiers.name: Hotkey modifiers
Shortcuts.HideShowModifiers.description: Modifier keys combined with the letter/number key below.

Shortcuts.HideShowKey.name: Hotkey letter/number key
Shortcuts.HideShowKey.description: A single A-Z or 0-9 key combined with the modifiers above. Falls back to "D" if left blank or invalid.

Shortcuts.LookupModifiers.name: Quick Lookup hotkey modifiers
Shortcuts.LookupModifiers.description: Modifier keys combined with the Quick Lookup key below.

Shortcuts.LookupKey.name: Quick Lookup hotkey key
Shortcuts.LookupKey.description: Type Space, or a single A-Z or 0-9 key. Falls back to Space if left blank or invalid. Bunbun defaults to B (Ctrl+Alt+B, "Ask Bun"): Ctrl+Alt+Space is taken by the Claude desktop app.

Bunbun.UseCase.name: Bunbun is for
Bunbun.UseCase.description: AI agents: coding agents on the island, as before. Office work: your working day instead (Work mode, the Work page and card), with the agent pages, cards and limits hidden. Both: the two together. Study: your timetable, study sessions and a daily goal with a streak.

Bunbun.Agents.name: Coding agents
Bunbun.Agents.description: Show Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor and VS Code / Copilot sessions (and any agent that runs the hook command) and approval cards on the island.

Bunbun.ShellApprovals.name: Ask before shell commands
Bunbun.ShellApprovals.description: Cursor and Antigravity don't tell Bunbun when they would ask for permission, so Bunbun can instead pause every shell command for an Allow / Deny card on the island. Claude Code and Copilot always get cards when they would ask.

Bunbun.Mascot.name: Bun mascot
Bunbun.Mascot.description: Show your mascot on agent pills, approval cards and the Ask Bun box.

Bunbun.AmbientFps.name: Ambient frame rate
Bunbun.AmbientFps.description: Frame rate for continuously moving content (waveform, marquees) while the island is not resizing. Resizing always uses the full refresh rate.

Bunbun.MascotOnIsland.name: Mascot on the island
Bunbun.MascotOnIsland.description: Show the mascot beside the clock and the music pill. With music playing it puts on headphones and vibes.

Bunbun.UpdateCheck.name: Check for updates automatically
Bunbun.UpdateCheck.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer Bunbun has been released, and show a notification if so. Nothing is downloaded or installed for you; the notification opens the release page.

Bunbun.BatteryMoods.name: Battery moods
Bunbun.BatteryMoods.description: On laptops, the mascot holds a little plug while charging, gets drowsy below 15% and cheers when the battery is full.

Bunbun.ChargingReminderMinutes.name: Charging update every (minutes)
Bunbun.ChargingReminderMinutes.description: While the battery charges, show its level (and time to full) this often. 0 turns it off.

Bunbun.LocalAi.name: Local AI
Bunbun.LocalAi.description: When Bun doesn't understand a question, a small language model running offline on this PC answers it or turns it into a Bun command. Needs bunbun-brain.exe and a model file; see the Local AI guide. Nothing leaves your PC.

Bunbun.LocalAiModel.name: Local AI model file
Bunbun.LocalAiModel.description: Full path to a .gguf model. Leave empty to use the first .gguf in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Bunbun\models.

Bunbun.AiBackend.name: AI engine
Bunbun.AiBackend.description: Which engine answers Ask Bun's questions. Built-in: the small model above, fully offline. Ollama: a model you already run with Ollama on this PC. Gemini: Google's Gemini with your own API key; it can search Google for current facts, but your questions are sent to Google.

Bunbun.OllamaUrl.name: Ollama address
Bunbun.OllamaUrl.description: Where Ollama listens. The default fits a normal install.

Bunbun.OllamaModel.name: Ollama model
Bunbun.OllamaModel.description: The model to use, as shown by "ollama list" (for example llama3.2, qwen2.5 or gemma3).

Bunbun.GeminiKey.name: Gemini API key
Bunbun.GeminiKey.description: Create a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey and paste it here. It is stored in plain text in settings.ini on this PC. Only your question is sent, never your calendar, to-dos or other personal context.

Bunbun.GeminiModel.name: Gemini model
Bunbun.GeminiModel.description: The Gemini model to use. gemini-2.5-flash is fast and has a free tier.

Bunbun.LocalAiIdleMinutes.name: Free the model's memory after (minutes)
Bunbun.LocalAiIdleMinutes.description: The model (about 1-2 GB of memory) is unloaded after this long without a question, and loads again in a second or two when needed.

Bunbun.MascotDnd.name: Mascot do not disturb
Bunbun.MascotDnd.description: The mascot puts its headphones on, closes its eyes and shows a Do Not Disturb badge, and stops reacting. Independent of Windows' Do Not Disturb. Ask Bun "dnd on" or "dnd off" to switch it; Focus mode does the same.

Bunbun.Character.name: Mascot character
Bunbun.Character.description: bunny, cat, dog, fox, panda, robot, spiderman, luffy, dazai, or custom:<folder> for a skin pack in %APPDATA%\Bunbun\mascots

Bunbun.MascotColor.name: Mascot colour
Bunbun.MascotColor.description: Per-mascot colours, e.g. bunny=#F4B6C8;cat=#5B5868. A mascot without an entry keeps its own colour. Spidey, Luffy, Dazai and skin packs can't be recoloured.

Bunbun.Assistant.name: Ask Bun
Bunbun.Assistant.description: The Quick Lookup box (Ctrl+Alt+B) becomes Bun's command line - open apps and settings, media and volume, timers, web search, quick PC facts, math. Fully local. Type "define <word>" or "wiki <topic>" for the dictionary.

Bunbun.Layout.name: Island layout
Bunbun.Layout.description: Studio (the default) frames the open island with a header (page name, date and time) and an icon tab bar with a volume slider, puts big Agent, Music and Focus tiles on the first page, and tints the music page with the album's colour. Classic is the original island without the frame.

Bunbun.TuckHotkey.name: Tuck away (Ctrl+Alt+H)
Bunbun.TuckHotkey.description: Ctrl+Alt+H tucks the island into a thin line at the top of the screen, coloured by what's going on, and pressing it again brings the island back (so does Tuck away in the right-click menu). Point at the line for a moment and the island peeks out until you move away. It comes back by itself when an agent needs you.

Bunbun.TuckRevealMs.name: Point at the tucked line for
Bunbun.TuckRevealMs.description: How long the pointer rests on the tucked line before the island comes back, in milliseconds. Longer helps in games where the mouse passes over the top of the screen.

Bunbun.AgentTab.name: Agent page
Bunbun.AgentTab.description: An Agent page in the scroll loop with a live timer, Read / Edit / Test / Done progress, the last command and its output, tasks done today, recent tasks, and your Claude Code usage limits (connect Claude Code to see them).

Bunbun.ClipboardHistory.name: Clipboard history
Bunbun.ClipboardHistory.description: A Clipboard page with the last 8 texts you copied, kept in memory only. Click one to copy it again.

Bunbun.QuickNote.name: Quick note
Bunbun.QuickNote.description: A Note page with one note kept on this PC (note.txt next to settings.ini). Lines that start with [ ] get a checkbox you can tick on the island; Edit opens the note in Notepad.

Bunbun.PokeReactions.name: Poke reactions and hello
Bunbun.PokeReactions.description: Poke the mascot three times quickly and it gets cross; six times and it gets dizzy. It also says hello when Bunbun starts.

Bunbun.StreamingMood.name: Streaming mode for videos
Bunbun.StreamingMood.description: While a video plays (YouTube, Netflix, an anime site, VLC...), the small island shows your mascot munching popcorn and "Streaming" instead of the title and cover. Music apps (Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music and the like) keep the song and the headphones.

Bunbun.MusicApps.name: Always music
Bunbun.MusicApps.description: Apps or sites always treated as music (song and headphones), when Bunbun guesses wrong. Names separated by commas, matched against the player's name, for example podcasts, foobar.

Bunbun.VideoApps.name: Always video
Bunbun.VideoApps.description: Apps always treated as video (Streaming Shows). Names separated by commas, for example plex, jellyfin.

Bunbun.LiveMood.name: Live mood while the screen is shared
Bunbun.LiveMood.description: While an app streams, shares or records your screen, the mascot goes Live, with a pulsing REC badge. Works with the privacy dots turned off too.

Bunbun.AfkMinutes.name: AFK after (minutes)
Bunbun.AfkMinutes.description: With no keyboard or mouse for this long, the mascot goes AFK and munches its favourite snack until you're back. 0 turns it off.

Bunbun.SleepMinutes.name: Sleep after (minutes)
Bunbun.SleepMinutes.description: With no keyboard or mouse for this long, the mascot falls asleep until you're back. On Windows it also naps after this long without you touching the island. 0 keeps it awake.

Bunbun.DndFollowSystem.name: Follow the system's Do Not Disturb
Bunbun.DndFollowSystem.description: The mascot goes Do Not Disturb whenever Windows' Do Not Disturb (or your Linux desktop's) is on, as well as with its own switch.

Bunbun.MusicSwipe.name: Swipe for the next song
Bunbun.MusicSwipe.description: Swipe sideways on the small music pill, or scroll sideways on a touchpad, to skip to the next or previous song.

Bunbun.IdleFace.name: Idle face
Bunbun.IdleFace.description: What sits on the idle island. Mascot is your character; Eyes is just two eyes that follow your pointer and blink. Pick their colour in Eye colour.

Bunbun.EyeColor.name: Eye colour
Bunbun.EyeColor.description: The eyes' resting colour when Idle face is Eyes. While an agent works they turn orange and pulse; green when it's done; red on an error.

Bunbun.ShowClaude.name: Show Claude Code
Bunbun.ShowClaude.description: Claude Code sessions, approval cards and usage on the island. Off ignores Claude Code completely; it asks in its own window as if Bunbun weren't there.

Bunbun.ShowAntigravity.name: Show Antigravity
Bunbun.ShowAntigravity.description: Antigravity sessions, approval cards and quota on the island. Off ignores Antigravity completely.

Bunbun.ShowCursor.name: Show Cursor
Bunbun.ShowCursor.description: Cursor agent and Composer sessions and approval cards on the island. Off ignores Cursor completely.

Bunbun.ShowCopilot.name: Show VS Code / Copilot
Bunbun.ShowCopilot.description: VS Code agent mode and Copilot CLI sessions and approval cards on the island. Off ignores them completely.

Bunbun.ShowCodex.name: Show Codex
Bunbun.ShowCodex.description: OpenAI Codex sessions on the island (hooks you set up yourself). Off ignores Codex completely.

Bunbun.ShowOtherAgents.name: Show other tools
Bunbun.ShowOtherAgents.description: Any other tool that sends events with bunbun-hook --agent <name>.

Bunbun.AgentPill.name: Pill while an agent works
Bunbun.AgentPill.description: The small pill showing what your agent is doing right now (Runs, Edits, Reads...). Turn it off for a quieter island; it still asks you when an agent needs approval or an answer, and the Agent page keeps track.

Bunbun.PillLyrics.name: Lyrics on the small island
Bunbun.PillLyrics.description: While music plays, the closed island shows the current lyric line instead of the song title. Also in the right-click menu under Lyrics.

Bunbun.MainAgent.name: Main agent
Bunbun.MainAgent.description: Which agent the Home tile and the usage ring in the header follow. Auto follows the one you used last.

Bunbun.UsageLimits.name: Show Claude Code usage limits
Bunbun.UsageLimits.description: Your Claude Code 5-hour and weekly limits and context use, sent by its statusLine when Claude Code is connected. Shown as a ring in the Studio header, on the Claude tile, and as bars on the Agent page.

Bunbun.AntigravityQuota.name: Show Antigravity quota
Bunbun.AntigravityQuota.description: How much of Antigravity's model quota you've used, from the status Antigravity keeps on this PC (refreshed when Antigravity syncs). Shows the model with the least left, its reset time, on the Agent page, and in the header and Claude tile when Claude Code has no numbers.

Bunbun.EyeStatusColors.name: Eyes show agent status
Bunbun.EyeStatusColors.description: When on, the eyes turn orange and pulse while a coding agent works, go green when it's done and red on an error, and change shape with it. Off keeps them your chosen colour.

Bunbun.IdleStripItems.name: Beside the face
Bunbun.IdleStripItems.description: What the small idle island shows next to the mascot or eyes. With a status ring showing, the face sits in the middle, this on its left and the ring on its right. Nothing leaves just the face, like a little creature living in the notch.

Bunbun.IdleName.name: Your text
Bunbun.IdleName.description: What the small island shows in the time's place when "Beside the face" is set to your text. A name, a word, an emoji.

Bunbun.StatusRing.name: Status ring
Bunbun.StatusRing.description: A thin ring on the small island, filling up as you go (right of the face when the mascot is on the island). Auto shows the focus timer while one runs, else today's water when you track it (Water in Timers or water reminders).

Bunbun.EdgeLight.name: Edge light
Bunbun.EdgeLight.description: A light that runs along the island's outline. Twin comets start at both top corners, meet at the bottom and go back; Comet is a single light; Breathe makes the whole outline glow softly.

Bunbun.EdgeLightOn.name: When the edge light plays
Bunbun.EdgeLightOn.description: Any mix of: hover, open, close, track (the song changes), notification (notifications, reminders, meetings, downloads, copies), agent (a coding agent shows up or asks you), system (volume, brightness, battery, Bluetooth, Caps Lock, timers), always. Comma-separated. Each plays the light for a few seconds; always keeps it running, which costs a little more power.

Bunbun.EdgeLightColor.name: Edge light colour
Bunbun.EdgeLightColor.description: Default is white; Dynamic follows the island's accent (the album art's, or yours); Custom uses the colour below.

Bunbun.EdgeLightCustomColor.name: Edge light custom colour
Bunbun.EdgeLightCustomColor.description: The light's colour when Edge light colour is Custom.

Bunbun.HomeTile1.name: First Home tile
Bunbun.HomeTile1.description: Automatic shows your main agent, or the weather when no agent is on. Pick it in Settings, Island pages.

Bunbun.HomeTile2.name: Second Home tile
Bunbun.HomeTile2.description: Automatic shows music. Pick it in Settings, Island pages.

Bunbun.HomeTile3.name: Third Home tile
Bunbun.HomeTile3.description: Automatic shows the focus timer. Pick it in Settings, Island pages.

Bunbun.HomeLinks.name: Your links on Home
Bunbun.HomeLinks.description: Up to four shortcuts under the Home tiles, as Name|address separated by semicolons, for example GitHub|https://github.com; Notes|C:\Users\you\Notes. Addresses can be websites, files, folders or programs.

Bunbun.PageOrder.name: Page order
Bunbun.PageOrder.description: The order of the island's pages after Home (or the player), as page keys separated by commas, for example weather,calendar,focus. Pages left out keep their usual place after these. Easiest to set in Settings, Island pages.

Bunbun.AppsPage.name: All apps page
Bunbun.AppsPage.description: A page with every page of the island, the colour picker and Settings in one grid, with a badge when an agent is waiting for you.

Bunbun.BluetoothLowWarning.name: Low battery warning for Bluetooth devices
Bunbun.BluetoothLowWarning.description: A heads-up on the island when connected headphones, a mouse or a keyboard drop to 20% or below. Checked every 5 minutes, at most once a day per device.

Bunbun.Sounds.name: Sounds
Bunbun.Sounds.description: Soft chimes when a coding agent finishes, asks you something or stops with an error.

Bunbun.SoundOpenClose.name: Open and close sounds
Bunbun.SoundOpenClose.description: A quick blip when the island opens and closes.

Bunbun.SoundVolume.name: Sound volume (%)
Bunbun.SoundVolume.description: How loud Bunbun's chimes are, on top of your Windows volume.

Bunbun.MirrorPage.name: Mirror page
Bunbun.MirrorPage.description: A camera and sound check page for a quick look before a call. The camera and the microphone only turn on when you press Turn on camera or Test mic, and off when you leave the page; you can pick which microphone and speaker to test and play a test tone. Nothing is saved.

Bunbun.ScreenTime.name: Screen Time page
Bunbun.ScreenTime.description: How long each app has been in front today and over the last week, with each app's own name and icon. Counts while you're at the PC (not when it's locked or you've been away two minutes, unless the app is full screen). Kept on this PC only, in screentime.tsv next to settings.ini.

Bunbun.ScreenTimeLimit.name: Daily screen time limit (hours)
Bunbun.ScreenTimeLimit.description: 0 for none. With a limit, the Screen Time page shows what's left of it today; without one, your daily average. Click the number on the page to step through 2 to 12 hours.

Bunbun.WaterPage.name: Water in Timers
Bunbun.WaterPage.description: The Timers page's Water mode, with today's glass, a + glass button, when the next reminder is due and the last week. Water reminders work either way.

Bunbun.WaterReminders.name: Water reminders
Bunbun.WaterReminders.description: Reminds you to drink, spread across your active hours. A reminder comes when you've fallen a glass behind your goal's pace, at least 20 minutes after the last one. Drank logs a glass; Later snoozes 15 minutes.

Bunbun.WaterGlassMl.name: Glass size (ml)
Bunbun.WaterGlassMl.description: How much one glass (one tap on Drank or + glass) counts for.

Bunbun.WaterBottleMl.name: Bottle size (ml)
Bunbun.WaterBottleMl.description: If you drink from a bottle, its size; the island asks you to refill it when it's probably empty. 0 for no bottle.

Bunbun.WaterStartHour.name: Active from (hour)
Bunbun.WaterStartHour.description: Reminders start at this hour (0 to 23).

Bunbun.WaterEndHour.name: Active until (hour)
Bunbun.WaterEndHour.description: And stop at this hour (1 to 24). The goal is paced across these hours.

Bunbun.FocusPage.name: Timers page
Bunbun.FocusPage.description: One page for your timers, around a big ring. Focus runs Pomodoro sessions with short and long breaks; Timer is a countdown you set by dragging the ring or scrolling over it (hold Shift for seconds), with your own presets; Stopwatch keeps laps and marks the fastest and slowest; Water tracks today's glasses.

Bunbun.PomodoroFocus.name: Focus session (minutes)
Bunbun.PomodoroFocus.description: How long each Pomodoro focus session lasts.

Bunbun.PomodoroShortBreak.name: Short break (minutes)
Bunbun.PomodoroShortBreak.description: The break after each focus session.

Bunbun.PomodoroLongBreak.name: Long break (minutes)
Bunbun.PomodoroLongBreak.description: The break after the last focus session of a cycle.

Bunbun.PomodoroCycles.name: Sessions before a long break
Bunbun.PomodoroCycles.description: How many focus sessions make a cycle.

Bunbun.PomodoroAutoStart.name: Start the next phase by itself
Bunbun.PomodoroAutoStart.description: When a focus session or a break ends, the next one starts a few seconds later. Off, it waits for Start.

Bunbun.TimerPresets.name: Timer presets
Bunbun.TimerPresets.description: The countdown durations shown as chips on the Timers page, in minutes (or minutes:seconds), separated by commas. Save current on the page adds the time on the ring. Up to six.

Bunbun.FocusGuard.name: Focus guard
Bunbun.FocusGuard.description: While a focus timer runs, a gentle note on the island when one of your distracting apps or sites comes to the front.

Bunbun.FocusGuardApps.default: youtube, instagram, netflix, reddit, tiktok, twitter, x.com, facebook, steam, discord
Bunbun.FocusGuardApps.name: Distracting apps and sites
Bunbun.FocusGuardApps.description: Comma-separated words matched against the front window's title and program name.

Bunbun.MusicApp.name: Music app
Bunbun.MusicApp.description: What the Music tile opens. Auto brings the app that's playing to the front. With an app picked, the tile brings it forward when it's the one playing and opens it otherwise (YouTube Music opens in your browser).

Work.Days.name: Working days
Work.Days.description: The days you work, as three-letter days separated by commas (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri).

Work.Start.name: Starts at
Work.Start.description: When your work day begins (24-hour, like 09:00).

Work.End.name: Ends at
Work.End.description: When it ends. An end before the start runs past midnight, for night shifts.

Work.LunchStart.name: Lunch at
Work.LunchStart.description: When you have lunch. Work mode pauses for it.

Work.LunchMinutes.name: Lunch (minutes)
Work.LunchMinutes.description: How long lunch is. 0 for no lunch break.

Work.BreakEvery.name: Break every (minutes)
Work.BreakEvery.description: A short-break reminder after this much work in a row. 0 for none.

Work.BreakMinutes.name: Break length (minutes)
Work.BreakMinutes.description: How long a break is. Being away from the keyboard this long counts as one.

Work.GoalHours.name: Daily goal (hours)
Work.GoalHours.description: The work you aim for each day, shown as a ring. 0 uses your hours less lunch.

Work.DaysOff.name: Days off
Work.DaysOff.description: Holidays and leave: work mode doesn't start by itself on these dates. Pick them on the calendar in Settings → Work day. Stored as dates (2026-12-25) and ranges (2026-12-28..2026-12-31), separated by commas; an h after one marks a holiday (2026-12-25h). All-day events in your calendar link titled leave, vacation, PTO, OOO, out of office or day off count too.

Work.AutoStart.name: Start with my hours
Work.AutoStart.description: Work mode starts and stops with your working hours. Off, it only runs when you press Start.

Work.Reminders.name: Lunch and break reminders
Work.Reminders.description: A note on the island when lunch starts, a break is due, you reach your goal and when your day ends.

Study.Timetable.name: Timetable
Study.Timetable.description: Your classes and study blocks, one per line or separated by ;: days, times, subject. For example: mon,wed 10:00-11:00 Maths; tue 14:00-16:00 Physics.

Study.GoalHours.name: Daily study goal (hours)
Study.GoalHours.description: How much you aim to study each day. Days that reach it build your streak.

Study.Pomodoro.name: Pomodoro sessions count
Study.Pomodoro.description: A Pomodoro focus session on the Timers page counts as study, inside your timetable or not.
